newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude closes firmer on technicals, NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude closes firmer on technicals, NYMEX.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures closed firmer on Wednesday on the back of some technical buying in a thin market and stronger NYMEX crude.
April Brent closed up 24 cents at $20.64 a barrel having briefly toyed with $20.74.
Traders said the contract had range-traded for most of the day, gaining a modest push at the end, but that liquidity was poor.
"25 lots would move the screen," said one IPE trader.
With industry functions relating to IP week in London keeping some players out of the market there were some opportunities for minimal squeezes, traders said.
"I think it will lose ground and shave off some of these gains because fundamentally it looks bearish," said one.
WTI gave some support having broken through $22.47 to close at $22.80 a barrel, just two cents off the day's high, but heating oil failed give any comfort to market bulls.
"Heating oil is being hit by the mild weather in the U.S," said one trader.

The market's attention was focused on American Petroleum Institute (API) stock data which is released later today. Traders said they expected a build in crude stocks of up to four million barrels and an increase in gasoline stocks of up to two million barrels.
March gas oil closed $1.00 a tonne stronger earlier in the day at $176.00, off a session high of $177.25. Activity was slender and the contract saw lacklustre trade.
